message: Execution scope mismatch in the expression '{0}': the type of the expression is {1}, but the sub-expression '{2}' is {3}.
rationale: The message quotes the expressions with backticks instead of single quotes, which also breaks its rendering in inline code, and it lacks the final period. The report site (TemplateAnnotator.GetExpressionScope) computes {1} from the type of the expression, not from its sub-expressions, so 'the expression is {1}' does not tell the reader where the scope comes from.
